name: Frigorific-Cairn
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near dust seas stretching to horizon that no expedition has ever claimed.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Approach protocols for automated beacon of unknown purpose are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
